title: Framework SQL built from input (gorm) — review required
description: A gorm data call assembles SQL from parts: db.Where("a = " + b). Framework helpers do not sanitize interpolated values. This lexical rule flags the assembly; the reviewer confirms every part is trusted or parameterizes it.
remediation: Use the framework's binding (? placeholders); never interpolate values.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any assembled query matches, including trusted ones.
